 (Des Moines) -- Prices at the pump took a huge dive in Iowa this week.
 Triple A Iowa's weekly fuel report indicates the price of regular unleaded gasoline averaged $3.57 per gallon across the state. Prices fell 25 cents from last week, and are up 89 cents over a year ago. The national average on Wednesday was $3.75 per gallon, down 23 cents from last week's price.
 Retail diesel prices in Iowa fell 29 cents this week with a statewide average of $5.57 per gallon. One year ago, diesel prices averaged $3.69 in Iowa. The current Iowa diesel price is 39 cents lower than the national average of $5.96.
